name: Flamedramon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] Activate 1 of the effects below.
・1 of your other Digimon may digivolve into a level 4 purple Digimon card with the [Free] trait from your trash for the cost.
・This Digimon and another of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand.
source_effect: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and any of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand.
